_about: Regions for measure.mjs on packages/testbed/src/lighting.html at ?frame=portrait&bare, 900x1200. Each rect was probed and printed before it was trusted. packages/testbed/alive.html shares the same framing constants (26 deg FOV, 0.42 m portrait height, eye line a third from the top, camera 12 deg off axis), so the same file measures that page too.

sclera.note: G2. Character's LEFT eye (image right, key side), outboard of the iris, clear of the catchlight and limbal ring. 11x6 px is the honest sample: the eye is 40 px across at this framing.

cheek.note: G2. Reference skin directly under the same eye and the same key.

faceKey.note: G1. Mid-cheek on the key side. The rig's key is at azimuth +42 from the camera, i.e. image-right.

faceShadow.note: G1. Core shadow on the mirrored cheek, deliberately inboard of the silhouette: the rim's band is the outer ~9 px of that edge and a patch further out would measure the rim, not the fill.

flatCheek.note: G4. 45x48 px of the flattest evenly-lit skin, outboard of faceKey.

litSkin.note: G3. Key-lit skin lower on the cheek than faceKey, so the two gates stay independent.

shadowTerminator.note: G3. Terminator band on the shadow-side cheek.

cardBand.note: G7. The two lash lines and the two brows — the only alpha-masked hair cards on the figure, and the near-black surfaces where a saturated rim reads as pure light colour. Each rect was drawn on the plate and looked at before it was trusted; they deliberately include the skin, sclera and iris between the cards, because G7 counts DARK outlier pixels rather than averaging the patch. Authored against alive.html?freeze&bare at 900x1200 in the rest pose.
